question: According to the 'Chaturashrama' of the Vedic period, which of the following terms is related to the period of family life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Grihastha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **According to the 'Chaturashrama' of the Vedic period, Grihastha is related to the period of family life.**
 
• **Ashramas are the stages of life which provide training and an environment for realising the ideal of our life.**
 
• There are four ashramas in all:
 
 
• **Brahmacharya (Student life)**
 
• **Garhasthya (Family life)**
 
• **Vanaprastha (Retired life)**
 
• **Sannyasa (Life of renunciation).**
